01-myeloid-condition-umaps

Sam Chen, Bicna Song

2026-04-29

  • Setup
  • Load data
  • Subset to CD28-41BB, 41BB-L, and STOP cells separately
  • Seurat reprocessing and integration for each subsetted object
  • Visualize UMAPs
  • Session info

Setup

# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(scCustomize)
library(MAST)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v5")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "downstream-analyses")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results", "myeloid")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots", "myeloid")

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)

Load data

obj <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "cart_myeloid_subtypes.rds"))

Subset to CD28-41BB, 41BB-L, and STOP cells separately

obj_cd28 <- subset(obj, subset = condition %in% c("CD28-41BB"))
obj_41bb <- subset(obj, subset = condition %in% c("41BB-L"))
obj_stop <- subset(obj, subset = condition %in% c("STOP"))
obj_b7h3 <- subset(obj, subset = condition %in% c("B7H3"))
obj_cd8 <- subset(obj, subset = condition %in% c("CD8-41BB"))

Seurat reprocessing and integration for each subsetted object

objs <- list(CD28 = obj_cd28, L41BB = obj_41bb, STOP = obj_stop, B7H3 = obj_b7h3, CD8 = obj_cd8)

reprocess_sample <- function(sub_obj) {
  
  sub_obj[["RNA"]] <- split(sub_obj[["RNA"]], f = sub_obj$sample)

  sub_obj <- NormalizeData(sub_obj)
  sub_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(sub_obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
  sub_obj <- ScaleData(sub_obj)
  sub_obj <- RunPCA(sub_obj)

  sub_obj <- IntegrateLayers(
    object = sub_obj, method = CCAIntegration,
    orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose = FALSE
  )

  sub_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sub_obj[["RNA"]])
  sub_obj <- RunUMAP(sub_obj, reduction = "integrated.cca", 
                     reduction.name = "umap", reduction.key  = "UMAP_", dims = 1:20)

  sub_obj
}

objs <- lapply(objs, reprocess_sample)
